bagPolicy.summary: Because the club is small, coat check is mandatory. During festival weekends, empty water backpacks are allowed, and management may hold LED accessories at the door.
allowed: Empty water backpacks during festival weekends

parking.summary: Spybar hasn't published parking details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Spybar. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold at the door, even when advance tickets are sold out, but door prices change with demand and space. An advance ticket guarantees entry. The dress code mixes street fashion, creative club and party wear, so skip flip flops, open-toed shoes and work boots.
